findings.reason: the §9 replay must resolve and enumerate its rows through the ledger owner, or the plan states why the ledger's reader cannot serve it; the same direct glob recurs at `reckon/mcp_views.py:1501`, so the owner and both sites should be named in one pass.
findings.text: §9's `load_committed_rows` hardcodes `Path(root)/"docs"/"state"/<project>/"runs"` and `glob("*.json")`, re-implementing the run-path resolution and enumeration that `reckon/ledger.py` owns (`ledger.run_path`, `ledger.ledger_path`, `read_records`); it also parses the raw JSON with the stdlib rather than through the ledger's record reader, so a change to the state-dir layout would silently starve the replay

findings.reason: a single owner for selecting the freshest dated reading removes four drifting copies; the sections should extend `window_reading` rather than each restating the competition.
findings.text: the "newest dated reading wins" selection is implemented independently here (`_freshest_member`), again inline in `group_position` (`budget_group.py:149`–`160`), again in `reckon/crew/window_reading.py:107` (`_newest_reading`), and a fourth time in `reckon/budget.py:2934` (`recorded_windows`, the `max(candidates, key=_reading_stamp)` at `budget.py:3058`); the owner of reading selection is `reckon/crew/window_reading.py`, and the plan adds two more sites to a rule it never places there

findings.reason: the plan should name one deep reader that hides dialect, age and selection behind one accessor, or state why the five types cannot be one, before the first node adds a sixth.
findings.text: the plan spreads one concept (a dated window figure with a dialect, an age and a serving state) across `window_reading.WindowReading`, `staleness.Reading`/`ReportedReading` (`staleness.py:36`,`52`), `budget._Reading` (`budget.py:279`), `rollout.QuotaReading` (`rollout.py:82`) and `pace.GroupReading` (`pace.py:72`); each is a small wrapper over the same fields and each carries its own conversion, so no single interface hides the dialect, the dating or the selection

findings.reason: the section must account for the interface surface it adds in its own text, per the rubric's one rule for every family.
findings.text: §6 adds the repeated CLI option `--ready NAME=GROUP:SCORE` to `crew preflight` and supplies the `budget` MCP view (`reckon/mcp.py:4292`) with the same source; the section says the MCP side reuses the existing `candidates` parameter but never says what the new CLI option retires, merges, or why nothing can be, for a family the brief hands over at 317 CLI options

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the plan's window/reading complexity is spread across several shallow wrappers rather than hidden behind one deep reader: `WindowReading`, `staleness.Reading/ReportedReading`, `budget._Reading`, `rollout.QuotaReading` and `pace.GroupReading` are one concept (a dated window figure) split across five types, and the "freshest dated reading wins" selection is re-implemented in at least three modules.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan re-implements committed-run path resolution and enumeration owned by `reckon/ledger.py`, and re-implements the freshest-reading selection owned by `reckon/crew/window_reading.py`; both are named below with the owner to extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1481, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §6 adds the CLI option `--ready NAME=GROUP:SCORE`, which the section never names as retiring or merging anything, or stating why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the machinery it extends rather than rebuilding it: the `budget_group` declared slot and the `quota_pool` guard from `burn-is-visible-before-it-bites` (§5b), `reckon/crew/prescription.py` for the open-endedness score (§3), `rollout_module.read_rollout_receipt` and `window_reading.read_windows` as the existing readers (§6), and `budget.evidence_shelf_life_minutes` as the shelf-life key the fence already reads (§5b.i).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one layer that is genuinely thin, `staleness.resolve_configured_reading` over the reader plus the lane probe, is justified in §5b.i (the shelf-life decision must live in one place), and the plan repairs in-plan the one wrapper that was not (`budget._run_observed_at` / `mcp_views._receipt_observed_at`, unified on the lower layer `budget.run_observed_stamp`).
